scientific_integrity: Symbolic proof establishes all prime powers. Exhaustive checks only cover specified small finite fields and quivers; no independent audit or external certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to explicitly split basic radical-square-zero quiver algebras over finite fields; loops excluded, parallel arrows permitted. General nonsplit algebras and full outer automorphism actions are not treated. An equivalent formulation under graph-gauge or torus-semidirect-product terminology remains a residual originality risk.
title: Tutte evaluations and full inner-conjugacy spectra of radical-square-zero quiver algebras
